best_match.name: UUNA TEK 3.0, 2 x 1.25 m
best_match.size: 78.74 x 49.21 in (2000 x 1250 mm) writing area. A 36 x 48 in sheet fits with room to spare.
best_match.accuracy: Repeatability +/-0.0039 in (0.1 mm), per the manufacturer. Absolute accuracy across the sheet is not published, so the +/-0.0079 in (0.2 mm) target is unconfirmed.
best_match.pens: The pen holder takes pens up to 0.6890 in (17.5 mm) across, at any angle from 0 to 90 degrees. That covers a 0.6299 in (16 mm) Posca and gel pens on paper, but it has not been tested.
best_match.shipping: Free worldwide shipping, as advertised. By sea, UUNA TEK pays the duties; by air, the buyer pays the US duty. Sales tax is added at checkout.
best_match.included: The plotter and an accessory kit: power adapter set, data cable and auxiliary regulator board. Wi-Fi and SD card are standard. Comes with UUNA TEK 3.0 software and also runs from Inkscape, UGS, LightBurn and LaserGRBL. 0.3150 in (8 mm) tempered glass base plate. No stand or legs are listed.
best_match.notes: Sold by the manufacturer. On sale from $8,999 with a Halloween countdown; the end date is not shown. Only two sizes are listed, 2 x 1.25 m and 2 x 2 m. Custom sizes up to 157.48 x 78.74 in (4 x 2 m) need a quote. No paid add-ons are required: the $500 license is only for second-hand machines. Returns are accepted within 30 days, but the buyer pays return shipping unless the machine is faulty. The air option declares a $125 invoice value; the sea option, where UUNA TEK pays the duty, avoids that. All in: $6,299 plus sales tax.

others.name: UUNA TEK 3.0, 2 x 2 m
others.pens: Pens up to 0.6890 in (17.5 mm) across, at 0 to 90 degrees.
others.accuracy: Repeatability +/-0.0039 in (0.1 mm). Absolute accuracy is not published.
others.notes: Sold by the manufacturer. Second choice: the larger size of the same machine, on sale from $10,999. Same shipping, duty terms and box contents as the 2 x 1.25 m.

others.name: Graphtec CE8000-130
others.size: Cuts 50 in wide and up to 164 ft long. Takes media 2 to 54 in wide. Tracking is guaranteed over 50 x 79 in.
others.pens: Graphtec oil-based ballpoint and water-based fiber-tip pens only, per Graphtec. Not confirmed to take white gel pens or Posca markers.
others.accuracy: Repeatability 0.0039 in (0.1 mm) or better over 78.74 in (2 m), per Graphtec and the dealer.
others.notes: A roll cutter that also holds a pen. Sold by a dealer (SignWarehouse) and drop-shipped from Graphtec. $4,895 plus $495 freight at checkout: $5,390 before tax. Stand included. Cannot be canceled, exchanged or returned. Software is not included and its price is not listed. The cheapest machine that covers 36 x 48 in, but no published spec says it takes these pens.

others.name: Graphtec FC9000-100
others.size: Cuts 42 in wide and up to 164 ft long. Takes media up to 48.19 in wide. Precision is guaranteed over 41 in x 32 ft.
others.pens: Oil-based ballpoint, per Graphtec; the dealer also lists water-based fiber-tip. Not confirmed to take white gel pens or Posca markers.
others.accuracy: Distance accuracy within 0.0039 in (0.1 mm) or 0.1% of the plotted length. Repeatability within 0.0039 in (0.1 mm) up to 78.74 in (2 m).
others.notes: A roll cutter that also holds a pen. Sold by a dealer (HeatPressNation). Same price with or without liftgate delivery. Includes a stand, fiber-tip pen holder, one water-based fiber-tip pen, media basket and software DVD. Freight is extra and quoted at checkout: the store's free ground shipping does not cover freight items.
